title: Automatic invoices
html:
The place for automatically generating invoices that are issued regularly, repeatedly, with the same parameters. Based on the parameters set here, the system generates customer invoices at defined intervals.

Important: tick the Check required box if you want to review or modify the invoice before it is issued (in that case it is created with open status). If you do not tick it, the invoice is generated automatically and, in the electronic case, sent out as well.

Fill in the basic data, the parameters of the invoice comment and the scheduling:

Use the Add item button to add the items to the invoice. After saving, the Activate button puts it live and the Deactivate button stops it.
